title: The Last Relay
who: master of a hauler waiting at the relay
want: Learn which lane a missing cargo hull took from the relay's last messages before the next long jump.
at_stake: A wrong guess sends your crew down the wrong lane and the hauler master takes his charter elsewhere.
complication: A manifest line's destination is redacted and its window closes before you arrive. (complications.md, scout 5)

approaches.label: Read the relay's whole message queue
Ask the waiting master what he saw
Plot the hull's likely lane from its burn
approaches.npc_reaction: has a burn chart of his own

Read the relay's whole message queue.clean: the hauler master pays your crew for the lane read from the stamped headers
Read the relay's whole message queue.cost: the relay's weak battery dies mid-read and your crew pays for a replacement cell
Read the relay's whole message queue.fail: the queue is too thin to read and your crew pays the master for the lost hours

Ask the waiting master what he saw.clean: the master tells other masters your crew listens before it guesses
Ask the waiting master what he saw.cost: the master gives your crew a lane but charges a fee for the favour
Ask the waiting master what he saw.fail: the master will not guess and your crew pays him for the wasted wait

Plot the hull's likely lane from its bur.clean: the master pays your crew for a plot that matches his own chart
Plot the hull's likely lane from its bur.cost: the plot costs your crew a jump of fuel to check
Plot the hull's likely lane from its bur.fail: the plot is wrong and your crew pays for the fuel spent on the wrong lane

sensory_details_used.sight: a dish pointing back the way you came
sensory_details_used.sound: messages arriving in thin careful bursts
sensory_details_used.size: no bigger than a small boat
